# L4.5 — Publish readiness: crates.io metadata v0.1.0, `hharness` facade, publish set + dry-run order, `rust-version`, release workflow, docs.rs readiness (ADR-0380)

Ticket: `docs/tickets/164t_L4.5__publish-readiness-release-workflow.md` · seq 164t · base `svitali/harnessharness-l4.4` · stacked on #190.

**Requirement ids:** `R-2.12.4` (packaging half) · the 2026-10-20 distribution rulings ("Also publish to crates.io" · "Libraries + installable bins").

## Summary

Makes `cargo publish` and the GitHub Release pure operator acts at
HUMAN-H7. Every workspace member now carries the complete crates.io
metadata set at version `0.1.0` with a deliberate `rust-version = "1.94"`
declaration; the publish set is 49 crates (the 5-crate fixture/plugin/
test-support set carries `publish = false`, recorded per crate in
ADR-0380 (a)); the new umbrella `hharness` facade re-exports the 46
publishable library crates under short module names with the
`tier-c1`/`tier-c4` removability contract forwarded (CC6 — the C4 members
are optional deps, so `default-features = false` removes them honestly);
and `.github/workflows/release.yml` builds `hh` / `hh-kernel` /
`hh-helper` for the ADR-0380 (c) four-target set with per-archive sha256
and a combined `SHA256SUMS`.

The actual `cargo publish`, the tag push and the release are **out of
scope** — HUMAN-H7, operator token, operator act. Nothing here publishes
or mutates anything live.

## crates.io availability — the run-time binding re-check

`scripts/publish-order.sh` re-checks every publish-set name against
crates.io at run time (`GET /api/v1/crates/<name>`, ≥1 s apart,
descriptive UA; 404 free / 200 taken / other inconclusive). Run-time
verdict **49/49 free** (2026-10-23T02:18:15Z–02:19:26Z — verbatim dated
per-name table in `docs/build/runs/L4.5.md`). A taken or inconclusive
name is a **STOP-and-ask** (exit 3) — never a silent rename, never a
quiet drop; the stubbed-collision legs of `test-publish-order.sh` prove
the stop path.

## What changed

- **Workspace metadata** — `[workspace.package]` gains `version =
  "0.1.0"`, `rust-version = "1.94"`, `repository`, `homepage`,
  `documentation`, `readme`, `keywords`, `categories`; all 54 manifests
  inherit, each with a non-empty `description`. Every normal/build path
  dep on a publishable crate carries `version = "0.1.0"`; workspace
  dev-deps stay path-only (cargo strips them from published manifests —
  and a versioned dev-dep breaks the in-flight dry-run overlay order).
- **`publish = false` (5)** — `hharness-plugin-fixture`,
  `hharness-tracker-fixture`, `hharness-compact-evict-oldest`,
  `hharness-memory-store`, `hharness-github-issues` (ADR-0380 (a);
  drift-checked red in both scripts in CI).
- **`crates/hharness`** — the umbrella facade: 46 publishable lib
  re-exports (`hharness::ledger`, `hharness::hir`, `hharness::embed`, …),
  `tier-c1`/`tier-c4` forwarded, C4 trio as `dep:`-gated optional deps.
- **`scripts/publish-order.sh`** — derives the publish set from
  `cargo metadata` (drift vs the ADR's recorded set is exit 2), prints
  the deterministic topological order over normal+build edges (Kahn,
  name-sorted ties), re-checks crates.io names at run time, then runs
  `cargo publish --workspace --dry-run`. Stub seam
  (`HH_PUBLISH_STUB_FILE`) keeps it offline-testable.
- **`scripts/ci/test-publish-order.sh`** — fixture workspace, 4 legs:
  free→ordered ok, taken→exit 3 STOP, inconclusive→exit 3,
  publish=false drift→exit 2. Registered in ci.yml's self-test step.
- **`scripts/check-publish-metadata.sh`** — full metadata set + version/
  rust-version inheritance + path-dep versioning + publish-set drift;
  CI step on the ubuntu leg.
- **`scripts/check-docsrs.sh`** — documents every publishable crate
  under its declared `[package.metadata.docs.rs]` settings
  (`cargo doc -p <crate> --no-deps`, `-D warnings`); CI step.
- **`ci.yml`** — `MSRV check` step extracts `workspace.package.rust-version`
  and runs `cargo +<version> check --workspace --all-targets` at exactly
  it (the declaration is verified, not asserted); all three new steps
  gated `!= 'fast'` on the ubuntu leg; `check-ci-gating.sh` green.
- **`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — tag `v*` + `workflow_dispatch`
  dry mode (artifacts only, no release job); 4 targets:
  `aarch64-apple-darwin` (macos-latest), `x86_64-apple-darwin`
  (cross-built on the arm64 runner via `rustup target add`),
  `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` (ubuntu-latest),
  `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu` (ubuntu-24.04-arm — confirmed hosted
  availability for this public repo); per-target `hharness-<ver>-<target>.tar.gz`
  + `.sha256`, combined `SHA256SUMS` verified before `gh release create`;
  every `uses:` SHA-pinned with the `# v` comment (ADR-0378 convention).
- **README** — Install section (`cargo install hharness-cli` /
  `hharness-kernel` / `hharness-helper`; `cargo add hharness`).
- **CHANGELOG** — `0.1.0` section filled from the round's landed work.
- **ADR-0380** — (a) publish set + per-crate rule; (b) `rust-version`
  decision; (c) v0.1.0 target set incl./excl. reasons (Windows: no
  containment backend — seatbelt/podman only); (d) docs.rs settings.
  `docs/adr/README.md` + `REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md` regenerated.
